tasks.name: Cancel for refund
tasks.description: Run the real airline agents over sequential user turns; score executed functions and actual terminal tool outcome.

user_turns: I need to cancel my upcoming flight.
Yes, flight 1919 from LGA to LAX, departing at 3pm ET on May 21, 2024. Please cancel that flight and refund my original payment, not flight credits.
Thank you. I have no further questions; please close the case.

required_facts.description: Preserve the airline policy and customer choice.
required_facts.review_guidance: Confirm the same flight and refund choice, explain 3-5 business days, never issue credits on the refund branch.

required_facts.review_guidance: Confirm the flight and choice, explain credits are available in 15 minutes, never initiate a refund.
